intent: A quiet, tactile glass workshop where one living beam remains readable through every transformation.

renderingStrategy.mode: Choose an engine-feasible Godot method after gameplay selection: layered sprites and shaders, authored 2D meshes, or a similarly bounded approach that survives the shipping camera.
renderingStrategy.feasibility: Prove one representative puzzle, one instrument interaction, and one complete beam reaction in the running project before expanding any asset family.

nonnegotiables: The beam path, direction, transformations, receiver state, and manipulable instruments remain readable in motion.
A production target is captured from the running Godot project at the shipping camera.
The representative art slice is accepted before the visual vocabulary expands.
Important states remain distinguishable without hue alone.
Presentation work preserves deterministic gameplay and reset contracts.

qualityDimensions.material_depth: Glass, brass, work surface, light, and shadow read as intentionally distinct materials.
qualityDimensions.focal_hierarchy: The current decision, living beam, and receiver form an immediate hierarchy.
qualityDimensions.beam_legibility: Direction, contact, transformation, and arrival remain readable at gameplay scale and through motion.
qualityDimensions.authored_specificity: The scene belongs to this intimate glass workshop rather than a generic neon grid or dashboard.
qualityDimensions.composition_typography: Camera, negative space, labels, controls, and type feel deliberate without overpowering the puzzle.
qualityDimensions.motion_feedback: Rotation, beam travel, contact, transformation, arrival, reset, and success have coherent anticipation and settle.

antiPatterns: concept art presented as a running-game target
building every asset before gameplay selection
raw grid primitives presented as finished art
default-font dashboard chrome dominating the puzzle
particle fog or bloom obscuring beam topology

views.purpose: Promise the workshop fantasy and invite play.
Demonstrate manipulation, hierarchy, and production feasibility.
Demonstrate the complete beam reaction and payoff.
